environment.storage: Disposable Namespace instance disk; SQLite WAL with default FULL synchronous
environment.distribution: Uniform synthetic tenants; not the Uze application
environment.scope: Heavy G3/P12/batching defaults; G1 and G4 declare their differing settings in each gate. Recovery is local.

g3.note: Two observations per variant: descriptive medians, no confidence interval or production capacity claim.

p12.note: Two observations per variant: descriptive medians, no confidence interval or production capacity claim.

notes: Durations are sums per metric family; overlapping phases must not be added.
No writes occur between restarts; replay can stay identical without an advancing checkpoint.
Stable window start is distinct from its 60 second confirmation.
C4/C5-a/C5-b have a known summary-finish timer status bug: success is recorded as error.

Stable window start is distinct from its 60 second confirmation.
C4/C5-a/C5-b have a known summary-finish timer status bug: success is recorded as error.
Quantiles of VM histograms are bucket intervals, not interpolated points.
Drain is residual work after sender emission stops, not sustained throughput.
SIGKILL happened after all acknowledgments, not during a commit.
Request errors exclude recovered OCC attempts; those are reported separately.

decision.oneWriter: Mechanism confirmed, but commit p95 increases about threefold; not a general recommendation.
decision.256docs: Ahead of default in both mirrored halves, but control drift and inconsistent batch-count mechanism preclude a causal throughput percentage; candidate for repeated/app testing.
decision.operations: Lab/manual process env only; Synapse recreate does not persist these overrides. No fleet change.

limitations: G3/P12 end-to-end deltas are inconclusive because control drift exceeds the signal.
G4 is observational; the two engines have different persisted search checkpoint states.
SIGKILL occurs after acknowledgments; no power-loss or mid-commit crash proof.
The real Uze workload and 37GB production file were not used.
Batcher profiles do not change the published image defaults. One-writer has materially worse commit tail latency; 256docs requires repetition and real-app validation.

namespaceCompute.billingNote: Elapsed-time compute estimate at the recorded Namespace 16x32 rate; not an invoice and not a quote for all billing dimensions. Max reserved compute remains 7.20 USD; actual elapsed estimate is about 5.58 USD.
